package pg

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/golang-migrate/migrate/v4"
)

func TestRunWithContextRequestsGracefulStop(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	m := &migrate.Migrate{GracefulStop: make(chan bool, 1)}
	started := make(chan struct{})
	result := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		result <- runWithContext(ctx, m, func() error {
			close(started)
			select {
			case <-m.GracefulStop:
				return nil
			case <-time.After(time.Second):
				return errors.New("graceful stop not received")
			}
		})
	}()
	<-started
	cancel()
	if err := <-result; !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatalf("expected context cancellation, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestRunWithContextAlreadyCancelled(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	ran := false
	err := runWithContext(ctx, &migrate.Migrate{}, func() error { ran = true; return nil })
	if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || ran {
		t.Fatalf("error = %v, ran = %v", err, ran)
	}
}
